title: Amazon S3 static website served by Amazon CloudFront with Origin Access Control (OAC)
description: Serve a static website hosted in a private Amazon S3 bucket through an Amazon CloudFront distribution using Origin Access Control (OAC).

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This CDK app creates a private S3 bucket, uploads a sample index.html to it, and creates a CloudFront distribution in front of the bucket.
CloudFront reads the bucket content through Origin Access Control (OAC), so the bucket stays private and is only accessible via CloudFront.
